hookups.source: rec.gov catalog for 232066 (all 15 RV/standard electric sites 011-028: 'Electricity Hookup' 15, 'Water Hookup' No; no site has a sewer hookup; 13 reservable, 018 and 022 first-come, none a host/management site) + rec.gov description ('RV sites come with electric hookups') + notice ('Please DO NOT attach your RV hoses to the water systems we provide'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 15 electric sites for RVs or tents (lengths 25-45 ft, mostly back-in, one pull-through) and 10 tent-only sites (1-10), most of them walk-in 15-50 yards from the parking spurs. One RV, or two tents and two vehicles, per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/la-vista-campground ('Campsites 1-10 are tent-only sites. The rest of the sites are camper or tent friendly'; 'The max length for RVs/trailers varies at each site') + rec.gov catalog (25 sites: 15 electric with Max Vehicle Length 25-45, 1 Pull-Through; 10 TENT ONLY) + rec.gov ('Walk-in tent sites are 15 to 50 yards from the parking spurs'), read 2026-10-27

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/la-vista-campground ('Accessible outhouses'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + rec.gov ('access to vault toilets and drinking water'; notice 'There is No Dump Station located at this campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: FS: open early May to late September, weather dependent; water, trash and a host may be missing early and late in the season. Dates are 2026's, when rec.gov sells first-come sites either side of the reservation season.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/la-vista-campground ('This campground is open early May to late September, weather dependent'; 'Seasons of Use: May through September') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232066/rates (2026 First-come, First-served Seasons 05-08 to 05-14 and 09-20 to 09-26), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve at least four days ahead (877-444-6777 or recreation.gov); a few sites are first-come, and the whole campground is first-come for a week either side of the reservation season. Two nights on weekends, three on holiday weekends; 'Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.' First-come sites must be occupied the first night; self-service fee tube. Run by the concessionaire ExplorUS.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/la-vista-campground ('visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay') + rec.gov rules (minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'This facility also has first-come, first-served sites') + rates (2026 Peak Season 05-15 to 09-19), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Every RV (electric) site $35; tent-only sites $30. Two vehicles included, $10 per extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232066/rates (2026 Peak and First-come seasons: RV ELECTRIC 35, STANDARD ELECTRIC 35, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 30; same 2027-2028) + FS page ('$30 fee per site for overnight camping. $35 fee for premium sites. $10 fee for additional vehicles'), read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/la-vista-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-27

note: San Carlos RD (Pike-San Isabel NF): meadow above the west side of 40-acre Lake Isabel, a CCC-built lake for non-motorized boating and fishing, in the Wet Mountains off CO 165 at ~8,600 ft. Bear closure order in place. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov rules/rates/catalog: confirmed 25 sites, 45-ft max, 15-amp electric (15 public sites, 2 of them first-come), no water/sewer at sites, $35 RV base, reservable on rec.gov.
